about.title: About the Evolving Skies set
paragraphs: Pokémon TCG: Evolving Skies is a Sword & Shield expansion released on 27 August 2021. It has 237 cards: 203 in the main set and 34 secret rares. There are also 132 reverse holos.
Choose what you’re collecting: the Standard set (the 203 main set cards), the Master set (335 cards, adding the reverse holos) or the Grand Master set (all 369 cards, adding the 34 secret rares).

This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies for trading, see your progress by rarity and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
